title: Fibonacci and Take
hints: An infinite iterator is a `for { … }` loop with no exit condition except `yield` returning `false`. `Take` is a `for v := range seq` loop that counts.
`Fibonacci`: `a, b := 0, 1`; in the loop yield `a`, then `a, b = b, a+b`. `Take`: return early when `n <= 0`; otherwise yield each value, increment a counter, and `return` when it reaches `n`.
